messages.subject: Error generating visual reports
parts:
Hey Vincent

First of all, thank you very much for your support.

I used GGIR like half a year ago and slightly modified the standard code in part 5 with the line (save_ms5rawlevels = TRUE,) to get some intermediate results.

However, I encounter always the same error which appears in part 4(translated from german):
Report part 4 loading all the milestone data from part 4 this can take a few minutes report not stored, because no results available ___________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________________ Generate visual reports
Error in 1:nplots : Result would be a vector that is too long
Additionally: Warning message:
In max(P2daysummary_tmp$measurementday) :
  no non-missing argument for max; return -Inf

I updated GGIR by adding these two lines at the beginning:
install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("wadpac/GGIR")

But the error persists. The csv file (save_ms5rawlevels = TRUE,) only contains the headers and is otherwise empty.

Do you have a suggestion on what might be the issue?

Best,
Jannick

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Error generating visual reports
parts:
Dear Jannick,

I am not able to reproduce your error with the file and script you sent.

Note that you have overwrite = FALSE, which could be the explanation as that will keep giving you the old results.

You are processing a file with no meaningful data, so we expect GGIR not to produce any output, especially not in part 4 and 5.
Report part 4 loading all the milestone data from part 4 this can take a few minutes report not stored, because no results available

This is not an error, but just a notification that there are no results for part 4. It is then up to you to understand from the part 2 output that there is no meaningful data to use for part 4 and that that is why part 4 shows no results. As I am aware that this notification is confusing for some, I removed a few months ago. If you still get this message then that means GGIR was not successfully updated for you.

Best,
Vincent
